defects.stale boundary: isFresh uses a strict less-than, so a request whose timestamp is exactly 300 seconds old gets 401, though the spec accepts at most 300 seconds.
defects.credit rounding: prorateCredit now calls Math.round on the signed value, so prorateCredit(501, 2, -1) returns -250 where the spec requires half away from zero, -251.
defects.malformed before signature: app.js parses the JSON body before the route runs and maps parse errors to 400, so a request with malformed JSON and a bad signature gets 400, not the 401 the spec requires.
defects.mark before apply: The route calls markProcessed before applyEvent, so an event whose effects throw is recorded as processed and is never retried.
defects.redelivery id: events.js redeliveryOf appends ':attempt' to the event id, so a redelivery is a new id to alreadyProcessed and its effects run a second time, though the spec says a redelivery keeps its original id.

decoys.decoy reordered multiply: Writing the product as unusedDays * priceCents changes the rounding for large prices, because the product loses integer precision earlier.
decoys.decoy dedupe after signature: Checking alreadyProcessed after the signature check means a duplicate with a bad signature is accepted as a duplicate.
decoys.decoy duplicate early return: The early return for duplicates skips signature verification, so an unsigned duplicate delivery is accepted.
